summary: Monthly gap-filled MODIS daytime LST (degC) from daily Terra LST + QC

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: Raw daily MODIS LST+QC collection to load (default modis_lst_daily).

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the monthly LST dataset to publish. Must have a registered dataset template.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to process as [start, end] ISO-8601 dates.
